{{unknown name|rom}} [[File:Poacher DP116.png|thumb|250px|The poacher]] The '''poacher''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP116|The Drifting Snorunt!]]''. This article will refer to him by his title, as he was unnamed in the episode. The [[Pokémon hunter|poacher]] pursued {{p|Froslass}}'s child {{p|Snorunt}} with his very powerful {{p|Glalie}}. He intended to sell Snorunt on the Pokémon black market, as they are highly desired and will fetch top dollar. However, {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and {{TRT}} stopped him, and began to battle his Glalie. Although Glalie defeated [[Jessie's Yanmega]], [[James's Carnivine]], and [[Dawn's Buneary]], [[Ash's Chimchar]] (after teaming up with the {{pkmn2|wild}} Froslass) was able to defeat it. Afterwards, both the poacher and Glalie were locked in the same cage that the poacher used to trap Snorunt, and was left for [[Officer Jenny]] to deal with. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Poacher |width=68 |pkmn=Glalie |type1=Ice |img=Poacher Glalie.png |epnum=DP116 |epname=The Drifting Snorunt! |desc=Glalie is the poacher's main, strongest, and apparently only Pokémon. It assisted the poacher in obtaining Snorunt, by frightening the Snorunt into submission through using Leer. It proved itself to be a powerful battler, but ultimately fell to [[Ash's Chimchar]] and a wild {{p|Froslass}}. Glalie's known moves are {{m|Leer}}, {{m|Gyro Ball}}, {{m|Hyper Beam}}, and {{m|Protect}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ice color}}|bordercolor={{ice color light}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] |cs=Libor Terš |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |no=Tommy Karlsen |es_eu=Abraham Aguilar |pl=Karol Wróblewski}}
